newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN refugee agency official kidnapped in Mali.
newsitem.headline: UN refugee agency official kidnapped in Mali.

text.p: An official of the UNHCR United Nations refugee agency has been kidnapped in Mali, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
The official was snatched from his home in the northeastern town of Kidal by two unidentified attackers on Sunday evening and taken to an unknown destination, the spokesman said.
The agency named the staff member as Martin Bucumi, 41, a Burundian who was head of UNHCR's Kidal office.
The motive behind his kidnapping was not known and there were no further details, the UNHCR said.
The Geneva-based agency said it was discussing the attack with officials of the West African state.
